# Resident Advisor Lineup, Artist & Venue Extractor

Resident Advisor is the main listings hub for electronic music events worldwide, along with artist and club profile pages. This actor pulls event line-ups for any city and date range, full artist profiles with socials and upcoming shows, or venue profiles with address, capacity and recent events.

## What this actor does

- Fetches upcoming events for a city and date range, with full line-up, venue and ticket details
- Fetches an artist's profile: biography, socials, follower count and upcoming events
- Fetches a venue's profile: address, capacity, description and recent events
- Resolves RA's two separate artist-reference formats (linked profiles and plain-text names) into one combined line-up field
- Empty fields are omitted from records

## Output per record

### Events by city

- `eventId` — Resident Advisor event ID
- `title` — event name
- `eventUrl` — link to the event page
- `date`, `startTime`, `endTime` — event schedule
- `venue`, `venueUrl` — venue name and link
- `city`, `country` — event location
- `artists` — artists with a linked RA profile
- `unlinkedArtists` — line-up names without an RA profile (plain text only)
- `allArtists` — the complete line-up, merging `artists` and `unlinkedArtists` in order
- `lineupText` — the raw line-up as plain text, one slot per line
- `genres` — music genres tagged on the event
- `isTicketed` — whether the event sells tickets through RA
- `ticketUrl` — ticket purchase link
- `cost` — ticket price as shown on RA
- `flyerUrl` — event flyer image
- `recordType` — always `event`
- `scrapedAt` — timestamp of extraction

### Artist profile

- `artistId`, `name`, `urlSafeName` — RA artist identifiers
- `artistUrl`, `imageUrl` — profile link and photo
- `biography` — artist bio text
- `country`, `region` — artist's listed location
- `facebook`, `instagram`, `soundcloud`, `discogs`, `bandcamp`, `website` — social/profile links set by the artist
- `followerCount`, `upcomingEventsCount` — RA profile stats
- `upcomingEvents` — list of upcoming events (id, title, date, start time, venue, venue link, genres)
- `recordType` — always `artist`
- `scrapedAt` — timestamp of extraction

### Venue profile

- `venueId`, `name`, `venueUrl` — venue identifiers and link
- `address`, `phone`, `website` — contact details
- `description` — venue blurb
- `capacity` — listed venue capacity
- `city`, `country` — venue location
- `followerCount` — RA profile followers
- `recentEvents` — list of recent events (id, title, date, start time, link, artists, genres)
- `recordType` — always `venue`
- `scrapedAt` — timestamp of extraction

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `eventsByCity` | `eventsByCity`, `artistProfile` or `venueProfile` |
| `countryCode` | string | `gb` | Two-letter country code for the city search (mode=eventsByCity) |
| `city` | string | – | City name or slug (mode=eventsByCity); falls back to `london` if left empty |
| `dateFrom` | string | – | Start date `YYYY-MM-DD`; defaults to today if left empty |
| `dateTo` | string | – | End date `YYYY-MM-DD`; leave empty for no upper bound |
| `artistName` | string | – | Artist slug or name, required for `artistProfile` |
| `venueSlug` | string | – | Venue slug or search term, required for `venueProfile` |
| `maxItems` | integer | `20` | Maximum records to return (1–200) |

### Example: events in a city and date range

```json
{
  "mode": "eventsByCity",
  "countryCode": "gb",
  "city": "london",
  "dateFrom": "2026-07-01",
  "dateTo": "2026-07-31",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: artist profile

```json
{
  "mode": "artistProfile",
  "artistName": "bicep",
  "maxItems": 10
}
```

### Example: venue profile

```json
{
  "mode": "venueProfile",
  "venueSlug": "fabric",
  "maxItems": 10
}
```

## Use cases

- **Local listings and newsletters** — pull this week's club nights for a city into a calendar or digest
- **Lineup research** — check which acts are confirmed for an event, including names without an RA profile
- **Artist touring trackers** — monitor an artist's upcoming show count and tour stops
- **Venue monitoring** — keep tabs on a club's booking activity and recent event history
- **Genre-based scene mapping** — aggregate events by `genres` across multiple cities

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with Resident Advisor?** No. This is an independent tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Resident Advisor.

**Why are there three separate artist-related fields on events (`artists`, `unlinkedArtists`, `allArtists`)?** RA stores line-ups as a mix of linked profiles and plain-text names. `artists` only has linked acts, `unlinkedArtists` only the plain-text names, and `allArtists` merges both into the full line-up in order — use `allArtists` unless you specifically need the split.

**What does `lineupText` give me that the other fields don't?** It preserves the raw layout, including which acts share a slot (joined with `+`), in case you want to parse set times or groupings yourself.

**How do I find the correct city value?** Use the lowercase, hyphenated slug RA shows in its own URLs, e.g. `new-york`, `los-angeles`, `sao-paulo`.

**Can I enter an artist or venue name instead of its slug?** Yes — both `artistName` and `venueSlug` accept a plain name or the RA slug; the actor resolves either to the right profile.

**Why do some artist profiles have no social links?** Only the links an artist has actually added to their RA profile are included; everything else is omitted rather than returned empty.

**Can I set only one of `dateFrom` or `dateTo`?** Yes. Setting only `dateFrom` returns everything from that date onward; setting only `dateTo` returns everything up to that date.

**Why did a city return no events?** Either the slug doesn't match RA's format, or that city genuinely has no listed events in the selected date range — try a wider range or a nearby larger city.

**How many records can one run return?** Up to `maxItems`, capped at 200 per run.

**Which countries are supported for `eventsByCity`?** 35 of RA's most active markets are available via the `countryCode` dropdown, covering North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific and South Africa.
